notes: All 15 source and 18 target ids are partitioned exactly once.
δέ and the adverbial καί are the two source tokens the ASV leaves unwritten; both are correctly their own unrepresented units.

The two τῆς tokens are rightly analysed differently: the first takes of the under rule 21, the second is the postposed attributive article of rule 31 and keeps only that, the determiner having stayed on the first.
οὖσαν is anarthrous, so who is a rule 7/31 helper on the participle and the head is is.
